written_before: any development learning run of this round (dev32 / dev256)
any timing or coverage run of Cover-TopK
already_seen_before_writing: support construction statistics of Cover-TopK / TopK at graph 0 (energy, swaps, repair cost) and the exact-optimum record sample (pilot_g0.json)
the analytic / Monte Carlo missing-input floor of the reduced task at init seed 20 (no training)
the previous round's development and locked-test (19000..19007) values (historical)

continuity.rule: dev32: TopK/8 and TopK/16, none and energy, data / SR seed 0, graph 0, at this round's code; reuse the previous round's 256-update development records of TopK/8 (w8_dev) and TopK/16 (m25_dev) iff every |heldout_final(new) - heldout_final(previous)| <= 1e-3 and the enabled-mask sha256 is identical; otherwise rerun TopK/8 / TopK/16 at 256 updates x seeds 0/1/2 x none/energy into dev256_topk

treatment_choice.rule: per policy (Cover-TopK/8, Cover-TopK/16, TopK/8, TopK/16): mean held-out (validation batches 9000..9003) after 256 updates over development data / SR seeds 0/1/2 at graph 0; energy (one-time row-energy restoration, cap s_max 8, the existing epsilon rule) iff mean(energy) < mean(none) - 1e-4, else none

fixed_treatment_sources.note: development selections of the previous rounds (verified records in results/weighted_random_supports_anchors: k8_graph_selection.json bp_norm / u8_norm, parent_treatments.json, m25_final_selection.json); not reopened

final_confirmation.evaluation: once after each completed run; final state + sha256 kept; no early stop, no retuning, all six seeds run

decision_rule.delta: paired per seed: loss(new) - loss(control) on the tkc29000 test
decision_rule.descriptive: pointwise two-sided 95 % paired t intervals (labelled descriptive)

secondary_rule: pointwise 95 % paired t intervals, labelled secondary / exploratory; no family-wise claim

graph_checks.treatment: the frozen final treatment of each policy (BP layout 1 = layout 0's)
graph_checks.reporting: separately; never pooled into the six-seed intervals

performance.screen: graph 0, 8 samples: TopK/8, Cover-TopK/8, TopK/16, Cover-TopK/16 indexed
performance.confirmation: graph 0/1/2 sessions, 24 samples, the 200M and 100M sets with same-session controls
performance.profiling_gate: at most one same-function profiling pass iff a Cover-TopK median complete step exceeds its same-session TopK median by > 5 % at either k (graph-mean of the confirmation)

coverage.rule: every exact timed support rerun at graph 0/1/2 (the corrected joint-query pass needs the per-query counts); historical exact values compared where the support fingerprints match

optional_solver_variant.trigger: (E_opt - E_repair) / E_opt >= 1 % at the median or >= 5 % at the 95th percentile of the stratified graph-0 record sample AND predicted full-model construction <= 10 min

pilot.sample: stratified (full / tail x unrepaired / loss quartiles), seed 20261029 + k

optional_solver_variant.decision: NOT triggered (gaps far below both thresholds; predicted MILP construction ~15 / 13 min > 10 min): no full-model solver variant is run

interaction.task: reduced raw-input diagnostic: D = G 1024, H 262,144, C256 / S64 / R256, one record per output, T16, hash 777, no projection, per-output affine readout
interaction.init: fresh K64 init scale, zero bias, the parent's readout calibration
